root_cause: Attempt 019's repair correctly selected the system xmin value into a record local, but the SELECT projection emitted relation.xmin without an explicit output alias. PostgreSQL therefore did not establish a record field named xmin for the later (final_head).xmin lookup. The failure coordinate remained exact because the record shape, rather than the source value, was incomplete.
recovery_boundary: Renderer 2.0.8 must lower every selected system xmin expression as relation.xmin AS xmin, while preserving record locals, the typed projection requirement, all non-system projections and all twenty behavior scenarios. A renderer test must reject every unaliased .xmin INTO STRICT occurrence and bind the complete accepted count before artifact regeneration, parse proof and a fresh independent veto.
